args.body: Read the committed products/distribution/invoice-checkpoint/2026-11-19-intake-readback.json and match it to TASK-179505361900 and the authoritative deployment record. Distinguish an intake change from a new observation window. If the verified cutoff has passed, reuse the existing verdict or save one retain, change or end decision for ACQUISITION, with separate fields for eligible requests, replies, explicit paid interest, accepted orders and Treasury-verified settlement. Mark incomplete measures unknown and name the evidence that would change the verdict. If the committed readback already contains the verdict, hand off its path without another fetch. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.
